climate_change_drivers: Rising Pacific sea levels (0.3-0.5m by 2050 SSP2-4.5)
Increased storm intensity and frequency (cyclone exposure)
Mild warming trajectory (slower than global average)
Precipitation divergence: wetter west, drier east
Alpine snow line rising (affecting hydro generation)
Soil moisture variability increasing (drought risk Canterbury/Hawke's Bay)
vulnerable_sectors: Agriculture (Canterbury drought risk, changing growing seasons)
strategic_priorities: Sea level rise adaptation in major cities
